method: Body-level eye sort of the docs/qa/battle-party/census/pair frames (the decide command-step frame, shipped build, party=vesper+maren, foes duskpad(m0)+reed-nibbler(m1)), scored against the placement rubric's own 'bad' clause read per body: 2 = reads immediately as a separate figure; 1 = compromised (findable, but part of it sits at its background's value or is largely behind a teammate); 0 = effectively lost. occTeam=1 marks a body whose loss is teammate overlap, which NEITHER ruler can see (the meter renders each body against a cast-free background, so a teammate never occludes it). NOT BLIND: the disagreement sets were computed before the looking. One rater.
